items.title: Keith Ingham interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I also love, have a deep love of New Orleans jazz, you know the old stuff, the Bunk Johnson things, the George Lewis things, they have such heart.

ctx.x: Well maybe playing will seem easy after this.

I’d like to say a final thing, I also love, have a deep love of New Orleans jazz, you know the old stuff, the Bunk Johnson things, the George Lewis things, they have such heart. And those guys could pick a tempo, that was always right for how they played. That’s the © Fillius Jazz Archive -20-

secret I think. I mean that’s beautiful too. I really love the whole spectrum of it. Not too much about now, but there is so much wonderful stuff that went there. It’s so inspiring because you can draw on that forever.
